EC1: 1. Significant co-morbid neurologic disease such as Parkinson's disease, [OR] multiple sclerosis, [OR] brain cyst, [OR] tumor [OR] or aneurysm;
EC2: 2. Major health conditions such as uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, uncontrolled hypertension, [OR] nutritional deficiency [OR] or uncontrolled thyroid disease;
EC3: 3. Significant psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia, [OR] bipolar disorder, [OR] anxiety disorder, major depressive disorder, [OR] or attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder;
EC4: 4. ADRC consensus diagnosis of dementia [OR] or mild cognitive impairment;
EC5: 5. Cognitive impairment when tested at baseline (defined as a score on any neuropsychological test of 1.5 SDs or more outside the age norm);
EC6: 6. Alcohol [OR] or substance abuse [OR] or dependence within the past 2 years (DSM-IV criteria);
EC7: 7. MRI contraindications, e.g. pacemakers, [OR] aneurysm clips, [OR] artificial heart valves, [OR] ear implants, [OR] metal fragments [OR] or foreign objects in the eyes, [OR] skin [OR] or body. Females [AND] who are pregnant [OR] or trying to get pregnant are also [NOT] excluded;
EC8: 8. PET contraindications, e.g. significant prior radiation exposure [OR] and pregnancy.
